methods.label: Cancel the common term
methods.explanation:
First note that \(x\ne3\), because the denominator \(x-3\) cannot be zero. For any allowed value of \(x\), add \(\frac7{x-3}\) to both sides. The identical fractional terms cancel, leaving
\[
x=3.
\]
But this value makes the original equation undefined. Therefore the equation has \(\boxed{\text{no root}}\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
methods.levelReason: Only denominator restrictions and adding the same defined expression to both sides are needed.
